profile.headline: Lead iOS Software Engineer at State Farm

positions.title: Lead iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
• iOS app development with Swift.
• Working on and leading impactful projects in a team environment.

positions.title: Java Software Developer
positions.description:
• Constructing and altering functionality to essential customer facing web applications.
• Providing technical solutions with Java, JavaScript, Spring, etc.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Served as a TA of Introduction to Business; 22 students enrolled.
• Lectured class on topics such as pitching ideas, resume construction, etc.
• Assisted students with material inside and outside of class hours.
• Aided the professor with grading assignments and business plans.

positions.title: IT/Systems Intern
positions.description:
• Conducted webpage accessibility testing with software including JAWS, ZoomText and Dragon.
• Installed and troubleshot above accessibility software as well as hardware, including keyboards, mice, braille printers, document cameras.
• Participated in “Hack Day”, a 24-hour company wide coding competition, creating a java-based virtual board game.
• Placed top 3 in the State Farm Summer 2012 Intern Pitch Program, a competition to come up with the best intrapreneural idea and pitch it to a panel of executives.

positions.title: I.T. PC Tech Intern
positions.description:
• Created, maintained and analyzed worksheets in Excel that kept track of equipment.
• Provided imaging, computer setup/takedown, and troubleshooting for over 5,000 employees with the rest of the PC Tech department.

positions.title: Technology Support
positions.description:
• Imaged and maintained over 500 computers and equipment in the three-school district.
• Provided technical support for the 150 district employees.
